description: Fix 2 code issues from semantic review: (1) narrow speakable selector to p:first-of-type, (2) remove misleading topic-level breadcrumb item.
steps: Step 1 - Narrow speakable selector: In apps/frontend/src/lib/jsonld.js, change the per-topic speakable cssSelector from '#topic-{slug} p' to '#topic-{slug} p:first-of-type' so only the lead definition paragraph is marked speakable (Google recommends 1-2 concise blocks).

Step 2 - Remove topic breadcrumb item: In apps/frontend/src/lib/jsonld.js, remove the conditional block that adds a topic-level ListItem to the BreadcrumbList. The breadcrumb should terminate at chapter level; topic coverage is already signaled via mentions and per-topic LearningResource nodes.
acceptance_criteria: Per-topic speakable uses p:first-of-type instead of just p
BreadcrumbList no longer includes a topic-level ListItem
verification: Run 'cd /projects/sandbox/-kalukaliya/apps/frontend && npx vitest run --passWithNoTests' to ensure no test regressions
findings: Both fixes applied and verified. 62/63 test files pass (same pre-existing AdminHealth.credits.test.jsx failures as before).
